storage_roots_note: private/ is local only. /workspace/private is the pod's attached network volume, mounted at the path operations/pod/boot_a_request.py seals into every launch request's volume_mount_path. /var/tmp/verbatus-runs is only the pod hand route's container-local working run root; pod_run copies each completed stage to the volume, verifies it and syncs again before reporting the outcome or releasing the guard. These are accepted pod exposures, not third-party transmission. `verbatus fetch-run` brings the volume tree home afterward; the volume itself is destroyed only per retention_and_deletion below, never as a side effect of export. gate.resolve_storage_roots resolves each listed root independently; an absent root is skipped and named in the pod run report, and an unlisted root is refused.
logging_rule: filenames and declared paths are retained in the self-hashed submission manifest and private refusal report because they are citation links; terminal output may give counts and the private report location, never image bytes
temp_file_handling: every write is a temp file in the same directory, flushed and fsynced, then linked or renamed into place; no temp file survives a completed run or a cleanup pass
retention_and_deletion: retain every run artifact, working copy, export, manifest and filename ledger until the run is dead and broken or complete and exported; only then may the whole run volume be destroyed. The corpus register under private/<corpus>/register/ survives run-volume deletion because it is corpus-scoped evidence, not a run artifact. Testimonia are retained pipeline records under principle 4 and are never subject to a per-stage deletion schedule
routing_rule: what produced a file decides where it is stored, never the file's extension
third_party_transmission: sending a real image or a transcription to an external API is disclosure beyond accepted local and volume exposure and requires the project lead's approval naming the vendor and the pages, recorded as its own approval artifact
cleanup_drill: demonstrated on synthetic material only: target paths absent, temp files absent, logs scanned clean, volume object listing empty where a volume exists; never a claim of forensic unrecoverability from storage media, snapshots, or provider backups
